title: Listings
intro: Your agency's listings: filter, sort, save views and change many at once.

picker.locationShowing: Showing {shown} of {total} locations. Type to narrow the list.

create.title: New listing
create.intro: Choose what it is and where; you fill in the rest in the editor.

fields.mapHint: Click the map to place the pin.
fields.mapFailed: The map could not load; enter the coordinates instead.

translations.locked: Keep this text (machine translation never overwrites it)

freshness.fresh: Confirmed as on the market on {confirmed}. Next confirmation due {due}.
freshness.due: Not confirmed since {confirmed}. Confirm it is still on the market, or it leaves the network on {hide}.
freshness.hidden: Hidden from the network since {hidden}: other agencies no longer see it. Confirm it is still on the market to bring it back.

errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Some values are not valid; check the marked fields.
errors.VERSION_CONFLICT: Someone else changed this listing. Reload it to see their changes.
errors.LISTING_NOT_FOUND: This listing does not exist or was deleted.
errors.ENERGY_RATING_REQUIRED: A public listing needs an energy rating (A–G or exempt).
errors.LISTING_STATUS_INVALID: The listing cannot move to that status from its current one.
errors.VERIFICATION_REQUIRED: Your agency must be verified to share or publish listings.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many changes at once; wait a moment.
errors.MEDIA_TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED: This file is not an accepted image.
errors.MEDIA_NOT_UPLOADED: The upload did not finish; try again.
errors.MEDIA_LIMIT_REACHED: The listing already has the maximum number of files.
errors.MEDIA_NOT_FOUND: This file is no longer on the listing; reload the page.
errors.MEDIA_ORDER_STALE: The files changed in another window; reload the page.
errors.LISTING_VIEW_LIMIT: You already have 50 saved views. Delete one first.
errors.LISTING_VIEW_NAME_TAKEN: You already have a view with this name.
errors.LISTING_BULK_NOT_FOUND: This bulk action no longer exists.
errors.LISTING_BULK_TOO_MANY: More than 5,000 listings match. Narrow the filters first.
errors.SESSION_REVOKED: Your session ended. Sign in again.
errors.VIDEO_URL_NOT_ALLOWED: Only YouTube, Vimeo and Matterport links can be added as videos.
errors.VIDEO_ALREADY_ADDED: This video is on the listing already.

media.title: Photos and floor plans
media.intro: Drop photos here or choose them. Files this listing already has are skipped; files stored anywhere on the platform are not uploaded again.
media.drop: Drop photos and floor plans here
media.hint: JPEG, PNG, WebP or HEIC, up to {max} MB each, {limit} files per listing.

reasons.type: Not a JPEG, PNG, WebP or HEIC image

media.altHint: Describe the photo for screen readers and search engines.
media.dragHint: Drag files to reorder them, or use the arrows.

video.label: Video link (YouTube, Vimeo or Matterport tour)
video.hint: Paste the link of the video page; only YouTube, Vimeo and Matterport are accepted.

bulk.allMatching: Every listing matching the filters (up to 5,000)
bulk.done: Done: {succeeded} changed, {unchanged} already as asked, {failed} not changed.
bulk.failedAll: The bulk action stopped. Listings changed before it stopped keep their change.

types.SHARE_SCOPE: Change who it is shared with

bulk.stillRunning: Still working ({processed} of {total}). Reload the page later to see the result.

quality.title: Listing quality
quality.complete: Nothing to improve: this listing has everything buyers look for.
quality.pendingPhotos: {count} photo(s) still processing: their resolution counts once ready.

hints.PHOTOS_LOW_RES: Replace {count} low-resolution photo(s) (under {minPx} px on the long side)
hints.DESCRIPTION_SHORT: Write a longer description: {length} of {target} characters
hints.LOCATION_MISSING: Place the property on the map
hints.LOCATION_APPROX: Show the exact location if the seller agrees
hints.CONFIRMATION_DUE: Confirm the listing is still on the market (last confirmed {days} days ago)
hints.NETWORK_HIDDEN: Hidden from the network: confirm the listing is still on the market

bookmarks.title: Bookmarks
bookmarks.intro: Your folders of saved listings, with notes. Only you see them.
bookmarks.noFolders: No folders yet. Create one to start saving listings.
bookmarks.deleteFolderConfirm: Delete this folder and its {count} bookmark(s)?
bookmarks.pickFolder: Choose a folder to see its listings.
bookmarks.empty: This folder is empty. Bookmark listings from their page.
bookmarks.unavailableHint: The listing was withdrawn, unshared or deleted. Your note is kept.

errors.BOOKMARK_FOLDER_LIMIT: You already have 100 folders. Delete one first.
errors.BOOKMARK_FOLDER_NAME_TAKEN: You already have a folder with this name.
errors.BOOKMARK_EXISTS: This listing is already in that folder.
errors.LISTING_NOT_FOUND: This listing is not available to bookmark.

documents.title: Documents
documents.intro: PDFs for your agency only (nota simple, contracts, plans): never shown on websites or to other agencies.
documents.hint: PDF only, up to {max} MB each.

errors.DOCUMENT_TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED: This file is not a PDF.
errors.DOCUMENT_LIMIT_REACHED: This listing has the most documents it can hold.
errors.PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE: The file is larger than {max} MB.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You cannot change this listing’s documents.
errors.LISTING_NOT_FOUND: This listing does not exist or was deleted.

overrides.title: Your text for this listing
overrides.intro: Rewrite the title and description for your own website and selections. The owner and other agencies keep seeing the owner's text.
overrides.noOwnerText: The owner has no text in this language.
overrides.hint: Leave a field empty to keep the owner's text.
overrides.saved: Saved. Your website and selections use it.
overrides.removed: Removed. Your channels show the owner's text again.

errors.generic: Could not save your text. Try again.
errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Write a title or a description (title up to 200 characters).
errors.LISTING_NOT_FOUND: This listing is no longer shared with your agency.
errors.DEVELOPMENT_NOT_FOUND: This development is no longer shared with your agency.
errors.UNIT_NOT_FOUND: This unit is no longer available.
errors.LISTING_OVERRIDE_OWN_TARGET: This is your own listing: edit its text in the editor instead.
errors.FORBIDDEN: Your role cannot change the text of listings.
errors.SESSION_REVOKED: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
